text: The moved non-functional story is published as one versioned baseline record on Day 1 with the following working read: the version baseline is Temporal 1.30 or later, for Nexus and Worker Versioning; one cluster per environment with its own persistence database, a namespace per workbench and one task queue per service named for that service; deterministic workflow code with all I/O in activities and no clock, randomness, Drools, network or database call in workflow code; Continue-As-New at every stage end and at least every 28 days with a stage child under parent close policy ABANDON; Worker Versioning plus the replay gate on every build; the AES-GCM payload codec with a key in Key Vault per namespace; 720 hours, 30 days, retention for closed workflows with the archive to Blob behind it; the four Keyword search attributes; the metrics and health endpoints and the Web UI behind Entra ID as the operations baseline; the availability objective of 99.9 percent in business hours and 99.5 percent outside them, with the recovery point and recovery time objectives recorded as the ACE objectives, which are open; and one conformance run per release and per environment. The supported version range, the compatibility matrix, the upgrade cadence and window and the measurement window remain open placeholders.
why: A moved non-functional story becomes a standard that a check can read, and the check cannot run on Day 1 without a version family, a topology, the code rules, the data rules and a cadence; the read sources fix the 1.30-or-later family, the five-layer topology, the deterministic rule, Continue-As-New, the codec, the retention, the attributes and the ACE objectives, while the exact range, the matrix, the cadence and the measurement window are named by no source, so those are adopted from the sources where they exist and left open where they do not.
read: Temporal 1.30 or later; one cluster per environment with its own persistence database; a namespace per workbench including `rwb-recovery`; one task queue per service and task queue `rwb-platform` for the platform's own runs; deterministic workflow code with all I/O in activities; Continue-As-New at stage ends and at least every 28 days; Worker Versioning, getVersion and the replay gate; AES-GCM codec with a key in Key Vault per namespace; retention 720 hours and 30 days with the archive behind it; search attributes CaseId, Stage, ProductGroup, QueueCode; metrics on 9090 and health on 8080; RW-PLATADM operate, RW-AUDIT read, RW-SECADM decode break-glass; availability 99.9 percent in business hours and 99.5 percent outside them; recovery objectives = the ACE objectives (open); one conformance run per release and per environment. Open: supported range, compatibility matrix, upgrade cadence and window, measurement window.
confirm: SCB IT infrastructure, the ACE platform team and security architecture at the platform infrastructure review before wave 0 exit
impact: If the read is wrong, the baseline record is reissued as a new version and the conformance check reports against the new values; the seven consumer stories re-pin the record, and no business value, schema or business rule changes.
